fields.title: LinkedIn post engager record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of the people who engaged with a post. One ENGAGER row per person, one POST row per post, NOTICE rows where LinkedIn published nothing and ERROR rows on failure. LinkedIn changes its markup without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The post URL that produced this record.

_source.title: Source surface
_source.description: guest-post-page, guest-profile-page, voyager-reactions, or none on NOTICE and ERROR rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: fetch_failed, auth_required or reactors_failed.

_notice.title: Notice
_notice.description: Explains an empty result that is not a failure, such as no_public_engagers.

_noticeDetail.title: Notice detail
_noticeDetail.description: What the notice means and what to change.

fullName.title: Full name
fullName.description: The engager's display name exactly as LinkedIn renders it, credentials and all.

firstName.title: First name
firstName.description: Split from the display name with pronouns, emoji hiring frames and credential suffixes (PhD, MBA, CFA) removed, so a mail merge does not greet someone as 'Hi Dr, PhD'.

lastName.title: Last name
lastName.description: Last remaining name part after the same cleanup. Null for mononyms.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: The engager's LinkedIn headline. LinkedIn only renders this for some commenters on the public page - expect it to be null more often than not unless profile enrichment is on.

profileUrl.title: Profile URL
profileUrl.description: Canonical profile link with tracking parameters stripped and country subdomains (in.linkedin.com, id.linkedin.com) folded onto www, so a CRM de-duplicates correctly.

profileSlug.title: Profile slug
profileSlug.description: The handle out of the profile URL - the stable key to join on.

engagementType.title: Engagement type
engagementType.description: COMMENT or REACTION. REACTION rows only appear when a session cookie was supplied.

reactionType.title: Reaction type
reactionType.description: LIKE, PRAISE, EMPATHY, INTEREST, APPRECIATION or ENTERTAINMENT, on REACTION rows.

commentText.title: Comment
commentText.description: What the person actually wrote. The highest-signal field here: it is the difference between a name and a reason to reach out.

commentedAgo.title: Commented
commentedAgo.description: LinkedIn's relative timestamp for the comment, such as '6d' or '16m'. It publishes no absolute time for comments.

currentTitle.title: Current title
currentTitle.description: Profile enrichment only: the person's current job title.

currentCompany.title: Current company
currentCompany.description: Profile enrichment only: the employer on the person's current role.

currentCompanyUrl.title: Current company URL
currentCompanyUrl.description: Profile enrichment only: that employer's LinkedIn page.

locality.title: Location
locality.description: Profile enrichment only: the city and region on the profile.

country.title: Country
country.description: Profile enrichment only: two-letter country code.

followers.title: Followers
followers.description: Profile enrichment only: follower count, a rough proxy for reach.

postUrl.title: Post URL
postUrl.description: The post this engagement belongs to.

postReactions.title: Post reactions
postReactions.description: Total reactions on the post. Note this is usually far larger than the number of ENGAGER rows: reactor identities are cookie-only, so the gap between this number and your row count is the part LinkedIn withheld.

postComments.title: Post comments
postComments.description: Total comments on the post. The public page carries only the first handful, so this too is usually larger than the rows returned.

postText.title: Post text
postText.description: POST rows: the post body as published.

reactionTypes.title: Reaction mix
reactionTypes.description: POST rows: which reaction types appear on the post, as a hint at how the audience received it.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: POST rows: hashtags used in the post body, lowercased.

activityId.title: Activity id
activityId.description: LinkedIn's numeric id for the post - the stable key across URL formats.
